text: 根据财政部周四发布的公告，孟加拉国政府一个委员会已批准不经招标直接采购八船液化天然气（LNG）的提案。 Blackcube International、Global Fuel Supplies、Plentitude Energy和Maxwell International将各供应两船。 财政部未披露价格条款。 公告称，中东冲突迫使政府不得不进行直接国际采购液化天然气。
text_en: According to a statement released by the Ministry of Finance on Thursday, a Bangladeshi government committee has approved the direct procurement of eight liquefied natural gas (LNG) cargoes without tender. Blackcube International, Global Fuel Supplies, Plentitude Energy, and Maxwell International will each supply two cargoes. The Ministry did not disclose price terms. The statement said the Middle East conflict has forced the government to resort to direct international LNG purchases.
